facility.name: Walkers Day Care
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Drop-In Care,Skill Classes,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 8432 LIVINGSTON ST, HOUSTON, TX, 77051

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: One child's file does not have a completed health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: Two children's files do not have physician or medical facility information.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(10))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily: There were two active ant beds on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §746.4751(a))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to suggest that supervision was not maintained when a nine-year-old child was able to leave the operation unattended, and ride a city bus to their grandmother's home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk: Based on the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to suggest that parents were not notified immediately when their nine-year-old child was able to leave the operation unattended.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §746.307(b)(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk: Based on the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to suggest that CCR was not notified within the required two-day time frame, when a nine-year-old child was able to leave the operation unattended, and ride a city bus to their grandmother's home.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Situation Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §746.305(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less: The loose fill was approximately two inches deep.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Six Inches if Equipment 5 Ft or Less (26 TAC §746.4907(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: There were two children ages 14 and 18 months playing on iPads.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2024 data revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2024 by January 15, 2025, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: Two of Five Children's Records did not have addresses for emergency contacts.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985): Four of Five employees did not have signed affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Infant Not in Crib with Drop Gate Down: An infant was standing in the upper crib with the drop gate in the down position.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Cribs - Infant Not in Crib with Drop Gate Down (26 TAC §746.2409(c))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two of five children's immunization records were not up to date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies: Three of Five Children's records did not have evidence of parent signed operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies (26 TAC §746.503)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Three large and active ant beds were observed on the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Three of Five Children's records did not have physician's health care statements.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates: Written daily plans posted did not have information identifying dates used or classroom used in.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Activity Plan - Group Name and Dates (26 TAC §746.2205(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: Children were observed using tablets in the pre-k room and cell phones in the school aged room that did not pertain to the activity plan or homework.    Both of these were corrected when the caregivers removed the electronic devices from the children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing: Two slides did not have loose fill under them. Three platforms did not have loose fill under them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Active Play Surfacing In Use Zones - Loose Fill or Unitary Surfacing (26 TAC §746.4901(a))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: I observed a changing pad with open cracks in the pre-k room and a changing pad with straps in the infant room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The light bulb in the school aged room was out, there was a patch of peeling wall in the pre-k room, there were broken toys cluttered in a corner of the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Three out of three caregivers were missing training in the following required topics; Emergency preparedness; Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases; Administering medication; Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic; Understanding building and physical premises safety; Handling storing, and disposing of hazardous materials
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The directors present  at the operation was missing training in the following topics; Emergency preparedness,Preventing and controlling the spread of communicable diseases, including immunizations,Preventing and responding to emergencies due to food or an allergic reacton,Understanding building and physical premises safety and Handling, storing, and disposing of hazardous materials
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: There was a few broken fence boards and 3 active ant piles on the playground.    The director treated the ant piles during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean: There were several broken/cracked or missing tiles in the infant room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Floors, ceilings and Walls in Good Repair and Clean (26 TAC §746.3407(9))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training: Based on the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to suggest that a child was inappropriately disciplined when they would not lay down on their nap cot.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments -  Associated with Food, Naps, or Toilet Training (26 TAC §746.2805(2))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: Based on the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to suggest that physical abuse occurred in the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: A review of the Employees Who Left Employment in 2021 data from February 23, 2022, revealed that the center had not reported the number of employees who left employment in 2021 by February 22, 2022, as required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: A childs record evaluated was missing the name,  address, and phone number for their emergency  contact person on their admission form.  Another childs record evaluated was missing the  address for their emergency contact person on  their admission form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants 12 Months and Younger: The operational policy handbook is missing the  safe sleep policy for infants from birth through 12  months old.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Safe Sleep for Infants 12 Months and Younger (26 TAC §746.501(a)(9))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: In the infant room, inspector observed an 8 month  old, laying in a crib with a pacifier and pacifier  attachment.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year: The operation has not practiced a lock down drill.  There is no documentation on file at the operation  for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(3))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups: Four children ranged from 18m to 2 years old were  observed during nap time. One child was observed  sleeping with a bottle and three were observed  sleeping with training/sippy cups.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Never Allow Toddlers to Sleep or Walk With Bottles and Training Cups (26 TAC §746.2505(4)(C))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For: A caregiver responsible for the 3y to 6y old group  did not know the correct number of children  present in the classroom. The caregiver stated  there were 11 children present. There were 12  children present during the inspection after  counting.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know Group Responsible For (26 TAC §746.1203(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: A childs record evaluated was missing the special  needs acknowledgment on their admission form.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist: The operation does not have a building and  grounds checklist on file at the operation for  review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Monthly Maintenance Checklist (26 TAC §746.4751(b))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year: The operation has not practiced a severe weather  drill. There is no documentation on file at the  operation for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drill For Severe Weather-Four times a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(2))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures: The operation is missing how children will be  evacuated or relocated to the designated safe area  or alternate shelter, including specific procedures  for evacuating and relocating children who are  under 24 months of age, who have limited mobility,  or who otherwise may need assistance in an  emergency, such as children who have mental,  visual, or hearing impairments from their  emergency preparedness plan.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, relocation, and sheltering/lock-down procedures (26 TAC §746.5202(1))
